finite_checks.name: weighted_sum_midpoint
finite_checks.claim: A nonnegative weighted sum of sampled convex quadratics satisfies the midpoint inequality.

finite_checks.name: affine_precomposition_midpoint
finite_checks.claim: The sample h(x)=g(2x-1) preserves the midpoint inequality inherited from g.

finite_checks.name: pointwise_max_midpoint
finite_checks.claim: The finite maximum of three affine functions is convex on the sampled pair.

finite_checks.name: infimal_convolution_split
finite_checks.claim: For f(u)=u^2 and g(v)=0.5*v^2, the best split for fixed x solves u = x/3 and v = 2x/3.

finite_checks.name: perspective_midpoint
finite_checks.claim: The perspective of f(x)=x^2, g(lambda,x)=x^2/lambda for lambda>0, passes a sampled midpoint inequality.

finite_checks.name: counterexample_negative_scaling
finite_checks.claim: -x^2 violates convexity at x=-1, y=1, midpoint 0.

notes: Residual means right side minus left side in the midpoint inequality. Positive residuals support the displayed finite diagnostic; the negative-scaling row is intentionally a failure witness.
